text:
mara (design): quick design check — proposal to split the current single "Approve" into two distinct affordances: "Quick pass" (fast, no audit) and "Sign off & record" (creates immutable audit). This is to align with reviewer vs final signer flows.

jon (product): curious — does the change aim to reduce accidental audits or make audit discovery easier?

mara: both. We've seen customers accidentally create audit entries during triage. Also makes it explicit who performed a permanent sign-off.

deepa (eng): backend can emit a signoff event for the record path. Recommend event name evals.signoff.v1 and payload: user_id, signoff_mode: quick|record, prompt_set_sha, count, audit_id (if record). We'll snapshot on record only.

sam (a11y): two quick notes: 1) visually similar buttons can be confusing with screen readers — wrap in role="group" and provide an aria-labelledby legend; 2) ensure each button has aria-describedby referencing visible consequence copy (don’t rely on tooltip only). Confirmation should be an alertdialog with focus trap.

evan (uxresearch): in interviews, wording matters. "Quick pass" felt approachable; "Approve" was ambiguous. "Sign off & record" communicates permanence. Suggest testing both verbs in a small moderated study.

mara: mock link pasted — layout idea: compact split with primary = Quick pass, secondary = Sign off & record (compact modal). Helper line beneath buttons: "Quick pass: fast triage. Sign off & record: creates audit entry."

jon: copy suggestion to reduce width: "Sign off + record" or "Sign off (record)" — shorter and scannable.

sam: accessibility nit: tooltips need keyboard focusability and aria-describedby for SR. Also announce completion with aria-live and move focus to results panel containing audit id link when applicable. Toast should be role=status and keyboard dismissable.

deepa: keyboard shortcuts planned: Mod+Enter = Quick pass, Mod+Shift+Enter = Sign off + record. Frontend will attach trigger metadata (ui|shortcut|api) to telemetry. For bulk operations >500 items we'll create an archive and include archive_url in the event.

evan: discoverability: surface shortcuts in a small hint near the primary on first run (dismissible). Users notice shortcuts if hinted. Test with two SR participants.

mara: QA checklist I'm adding to the PR: focus order, aria labels and descriptions, modal semantics, keyboard shortcuts, toast contains audit id + link, bulk confirm shows counts and a short domain summary (not full listing), contrast tokens.

jon: rollout plan: behind org-level feature flag. Default stays the same for small orgs. Enable for beta enterprise orgs first. Metrics to watch: pct quick vs record, undo within 2 minutes, time-to-approve.

deploy-bot: Created issue #5123: "evals: split quick pass + signoff (audit)" and assigned to deepa.

jon: decision: proceed with Quick pass / Sign off + record behind a flag, include keyboard shortcuts and a11y callouts, beta to one enterprise org.

mara: action items: @deepa open schema PR and branch, @sam add a11y checklist to PR template, @evan schedule 6 usability sessions (include 2 SR). I'll update figma and post link when branch is live.

deepa: ack, will open branch tomorrow and attach schema draft.

sam: will draft checklist and post to repo.

evan: invites sent.

mara: thanks all — will post updated mocks once branch lands. :thumbsup:
